title: Fooling set bound from communication complexity
statement: Let $g : X \times Y \to \alpha$ be a two-argument function, and let $S \subseteq X \times Y$ be a fooling set for $g$, meaning that $S$ meets every $g$-monochromatic rectangle in at most one point. If the deterministic communication complexity of $g$ satisfies $D(g) \le n$ for some $n \in \bbn$, then the cardinality of $S$ satisfies $\abs{S} \le 2^{n}$.
hypotheses_covered: S is a fooling set for g
deterministic communication complexity of g is at most n
replaced:
If $\mathrm{CC}(g) \leq n$ and $S \subseteq X \times Y$ is a fooling set for $g$, then
$|S| \leq 2^n$.
